acceptance: A generic command, not zmux-specific, prints active projects one path per line, in zoxide's frecency order. A project is a directory holding .git or .project, and never $HOME. Linked worktrees, ~/.config/emacs/elpa and /workspace are left out. ~/flakes is included. Absent directories are skipped. Silent and exit 0 with no zoxide database. It lives where the ~/flakes agent judges right, since other tools are expected to use it.
notes: Offered to the ~/flakes agent with tk-flakes-wire, on the operator's say. The exclusions were seen in zoxide on Sleipnir, 2026-11-06. Whether .jj should also count is open: zp treats it as a marker, and the operator named .git and .project.
title: List active projects from zoxide
